scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a hotel lobby with a large open space and high ceilings, featuring a reception desk and seating area. The floor is made of marble and has a geometric pattern. The walls are made of wood and have several windows. There are several tables and chairs scattered throughout the room. The lighting is bright and modern.
